source.label: A16Z Speedrun 006 all-platform source hunt by Codex agent
taskConstraints: Do not edit shared source JSON.
Accepted evidence must be post/video/comment/repo-level URL; no profiles/search pages.
Accepted evidence must have visible metrics.
Top-voice evidence must be native posts by people listed in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts with visible company/founder context.
notes: Shared source JSON files were read only.
GitHub API was rate-limited after an exploratory pass; accepted GitHub rows rely on visible earlier API output plus existing saved repo snapshot.
LinkedIn public post pages exposed post text and visible reaction/comment counters without login for accepted rows.
